articles.title: The Secret Ingredient That Turns a Bee Larva into a Queen
articles.summary: Royal jelly isn't the only thing that makes a queen bee. Scientists found the wax in her special room is softer and has different chemicals. That wax helps turn a regular larva into royalty.

articles.title: Starship Survives 24 Days at Sea and Floats to Christmas Island!
articles.summary: SpaceX's Starship rocket part survived a splashdown in the ocean and a 24-day tugboat journey. It's now near Christmas Island, where engineers will study it. This is the first time a Starship came back in one piece.

articles.title: Could the Whole Universe Be Alive and Evolving Like a Creature?
articles.summary: Some scientists think universes might reproduce through black holes, just like living things have babies. New universes could inherit traits and evolve over time. It's a wild idea that's getting more attention.
